scenarios.root_cause: The refactor introduced `_get_item_or_404` (lines 47‑51) which only validates existence (404) but drops the ownership check that previously guarded `read_item`. The original lines 58‑59 (`if not current_user.is_superuser and (item.owner_id != current_user.id): raise HTTPException(403,…)`) are no longer executed, so any authenticated user can now read any item by ID — a classic IDOR / broken object-level authorization (OWASP API1:2023, CWE‑639). Fix: restore the authorization logic in `read_item` after calling the helper, or add an `owner_id`/`current_user` parameter to `_get_item_or_404` and enforce the 403 there.
